generator: generate.mjs (node generate.mjs regenerates shared/site.css, before/*.html, after/*.html)
layout: before/<id>.html and after/<id>.html share shared/site.css (design tokens in :root). Each pair is rendered at viewport widths 390 and 1280, full page, deviceScaleFactor 1, headless Chromium 1194 (playwright-core 1.64.1).

seeded.what: 2 px vertical shift of the price-table section and everything below it; page height grows by 2 px (2331->2333 at 390, 1267->1269 at 1280)
seeded.should_catch: any pixel diff; image sizes differ so the comparer must pad, not abort

seeded.what: accent colour token changed by 4/255 in the blue channel only; affects header bar, buttons, badges, links (~3.9% / 5.6% of page pixels at 390 / 1280)
seeded.should_catch: colour threshold; pixelmatch default 0.1 (OKLab HyAB distance) does NOT see it, needs threshold <= 0.005

seeded.what: the 'Editor pick' badge on product card 2 is hidden (76x26 px block)
seeded.should_catch: any pixel diff; bounding box should be ~76x26 at the card's top-left

seeded.what: font fallback: body text renders in Liberation Sans (Arial alias) instead of Inter. NOTE: the brief suggested changing to a "Segoe UI" stack, but fontconfig on this box aliases "Segoe UI" to Inter (fc-match "Segoe UI" -> Inter-Regular.otf; canvas measureText identical), which produced a 0-pixel diff, so the stack was changed to Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif (-> Liberation Sans, a different installed font).
seeded.should_catch: any pixel diff over the whole text area

controls.what: identical HTML; a .live-status bar ([data-dynamic]) renders a timestamp (new Date()) and a random visitors-online number via JS, so raw screenshots always differ in that bar

identical content; the hero paragraph gets transform:translateX(0px) (before) vs translateX(0.4px) (after): no pixel of layout moves, only glyph anti-aliasing changes (raw pixelmatch 0.1 diff ~2500-2700 px)
controls.expected: 0 reported changes with the tuned config

notes: Pages have no external resources (no images/fonts fetched) so they render fully offline. Header nav hides two links below 700 px so the 390 px page does not overflow horizontally.
